rules.summary: WHENEVER BURGLAR ALARM, ANY AREA (item 1) THEN result type 3 (2,3,0,0) THEN result type 4 (0,2,3,0)
WHENEVER AREA 1 ARM STATE THEN result type 3 (0,3,0,0)
WHENEVER trigger type 2 (1,0,6,0) AND trigger type 6 (1,6,0,0) AND trigger type 7 (1,10,0,0) THEN result type 8: text "Happy Birthday  Mr. Smith"
WHENEVER AREA 1 ENTRY DELAY (item 1) AND DARK (item 1) THEN result type 4 (0,1,3,0)
WHENEVER AREA 1 IS ARMED AWAY (item 1) AND trigger type 10 (1,0,0,0) THEN result type 4 (0,0,3,0)
WHENEVER trigger type 2 (1,0,23,0) THEN result type 4 (0,0,4,0) THEN result type 4 (0,1,4,0)
